title: The Algebra of Abu Kamil
lineage: Full journal article retained; only the cited historical passage was inspected. The claim of dependence is the historian’s reconstruction, not a direct attribution in al-Fakhrī; the original compared texts were not inspected.

passages.locator: Printed p. 38 / PDF p. 3, The Second Great Arabic Writer on Algebra
passages.note: Historian identifies al-Karajī’s use of Abū Kāmil’s algebraic problems and solutions, while noting he did not name Abū Kāmil; gives a death estimate of c. 1029.
